title: Rice ties Utah in third-place match at Jackson T. Stephens Cup
text:
Rice ties Utah in third-place match at Jackson T. Stephens Cup
Rice fought back from an early deficit to tie Utah, 2.5-2.5, in the third-place match at the Jackson T. Stephens Cup in Frisco, Texas, on Sep. 16.
Raines Watson lost his match to Jack Jerge, 4 and 3, after being just one down through eleven holes but dropping three of the next four holes. Reggie Zhu came from behind to defeat Ivan Enguita, 2-Up, securing victory with a birdie on the final hole after a close contest throughout their round.
Henry Daly was defeated by Gabriel Palacios, 2 and 1. Daly managed to extend his match with a birdie on the sixteenth hole, but both players parred the seventeenth, which clinched Palacios's win. Nolan Kuszyk tied Will Pizza after overcoming an early three-hole deficit; Kuszyk leveled the match by parring the fourteenth and forced a tie when Pizza bogeyed the eighteenth.
Davis Byrd closed out Rice's scoring with a 2-Up win over Sergio Jimenez. Byrd trailed during parts of his round but regained control with a birdie on fifteen and sealed victory with another birdie on eighteen.
Head coach Justin Emil said, "We were 5-down, losing all of the matches, and the guys fought back in a huge way. Utah is a really good team, and our guys showed what they can do out there this week. I'm excited to see us build on a solid week in Frisco."
The Owls will next host their only tournament of the year at the Bayou City Collegiate Classic at Westwood Golf Club in Houston from Sept. 21-22.
